title: The Role of Modal Substitution in Rebound Effects Within US Freight Transportation
Decline in traffic congestion increased accident severity in the wake of COVID-19
Food vs. Fuel? Impacts of petroleum shipments on agricultural prices
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Grain shippers and political figures in North Dakota and nearby states have voiced concern that the dramatic increases in shipments of crude oil by rail have caused service delays and higher costs. We investigate the potential impact of crude shipments on grain markets accounting for harvest effects and other potential sources of rail congestion. Increased crude oil shipments are associated with substantially larger spreads between wheat prices at regional elevators and in Minneapolis, the market hub. The effect on corn and soybean spreads are an order of magnitude smaller. Increased oil traffic is associated with small increases in rail rates but large increases in rail car auction prices. We document increases in wheat carry (storage) costs and decreases in shipment quantities. Surprisingly, little of the spread increase is due to lower prices paid to farmers, suggesting consumers rather than producers paid the cost of increased rail congestion.
abstract_zh: 北达科他州及邻近各州的粮食托运商和政界人士担忧，原油铁路运输量的急剧增长导致了运输延误和成本上升。我们在考虑收获效应及其他可能的铁路拥堵来源的情况下，考察了原油运输对粮食市场的潜在影响。原油运输量的增加与区域粮仓小麦价格和作为市场枢纽的明尼阿波利斯小麦价格之间的价差大幅扩大相关。对玉米和大豆价差的影响则小一个数量级。石油运输量的增加与铁路运价的小幅上涨相关，但与铁路车皮拍卖价格的大幅上涨相关。我们记录了小麦仓储（储存）成本的上升以及运输量的下降。令人惊讶的是，价差扩大的部分原因很少来自农民所获价格的降低，这表明是消费者而非生产者承担了铁路拥堵加剧的成本。

title: The Value of Rarity: Evidence from a Collectible Good
Who (Else) Benefits from Electricity Deregulation?
abstract: The movement to deregulate major industries over the past 40 years has produced large efficiency gains. However, distributional effects have been more difficult to assess. In the electricity sector, deregulation has vastly increased information available to market participants through the formation of wholesale markets. We test whether upstream suppliers, specifically railroads that transport coal from mines to power plants, use this information to capture economic rents that would otherwise accrue to electricity generators. Using natural gas prices as a proxy for generators’ surplus, we find railroads charge higher markups when rents are larger. This effect is larger for deregulated plants, high-lighting an important distributional impact of deregulation. This also means policies that change fuel prices can have substantially different effects on downstream consumers in regulated and deregulated markets.
abstract_zh: 过去40年来，放松主要行业管制的运动带来了巨大的效率收益。然而，其分配效应则更难评估。在电力行业，批发市场的形成极大地增加了市场参与者可获得的信息。我们检验上游供应商——特别是将煤炭从矿山运往发电厂的铁路公司——是否利用这些信息攫取了原本会归于发电企业的经济租金。以天然气价格作为发电企业剩余的代理变量，我们发现，当租金较大时，铁路公司收取的加成更高。这一效应在放松管制的电厂中更为显著，凸显了放松管制所带来的一个重要分配影响。这也意味着，改变燃料价格的政策，对受管制市场与放松管制市场中的下游消费者可能产生截然不同的影响。

title: Getting Green with Solar Subsidies: Evidence from the California Solar Initiative
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Subsidies to promote energy efficiency and renewable energy have been widely adopted. We study the California Solar Initiative and find upfront rebates have a large effect on residential solar installations. We exploit variation in rebate rates across electric utilities over time and control for time-varying factors that affect solar adoption. Our preferred estimates suggest increasing rebates from $5,600 to $6,070 would increase installations by 10%. Overall, we predict 53% fewer installations would have occurred without subsidies. Over 20 years, these additional installations reduce carbon dioxide emissions between 2.3 and 3.4 million metric tons and local air pollutants (NOx) by 1,100 to 1,700 metric tons. Of the $440 million in rebates awarded, $121 million were rents to installations that would have occurred absent rebates. We estimate program costs of $0.06 per kilowatt hour and between $130 and $196 per metric ton of carbon dioxide.
abstract_zh: 促进能效和可再生能源的补贴已被广泛采用。我们研究加州太阳能计划（California Solar Initiative），发现预付返利对居民太阳能装置的安装有很大影响。我们利用各电力公司随时间变化的返利率差异，并控制影响太阳能采用的时变因素。我们偏好的估计表明，将返利从5,600美元提高到6,070美元，将使装置安装数量增加10%。总体而言，我们预测，若无补贴，装置安装数量将减少53%。在20年间，这些额外装置减少了230万至340万公吨的二氧化碳排放，以及1,100至1,700公吨的当地空气污染物（氮氧化物，NOx）。在已发放的4.4亿美元返利中，有1.21亿美元成为对那些即使没有返利也会安装的装置的租金。我们估计，项目成本为每千瓦时0.06美元，每公吨二氧化碳的成本为130至196美元。

title: Some Inconvenient Truths About Climate Change Policy: The Distributional Impacts of Transportation Policies
venue: The Review of Economics and Statistics
abstract: Climate policy has favored costly measures that implicitly or explicitly subsidize lowcarbon fuels. We simulate four transportation sector policies: cap and trade (CAT), ethanol subsidies, a renewable fuel standard (RFS), and a lowcarbon fuel standard. Our simulations confirm that alternatives to CAT are 2.5 to 4 times more costly but are amenable to adoption due to right-skewed distributions of gains. We analyze voting on the Waxman-Markey (WM) CAT bill. Conditional on a district’s CAT gains, a district’s RFS gains are negatively correlated with the likelihood of voting for WM. Our analysis supports campaign contributions as a partial mechanism.
abstract_zh: 气候政策一直偏好那些代价高昂的措施，这些措施隐含或明确地补贴低碳燃料。我们模拟了四种交通运输部门的政策：总量控制与交易（CAT）、乙醇补贴、可再生燃料标准（RFS）以及低碳燃料标准。我们的模拟证实，CAT的替代方案成本高出2.5至4倍，但由于收益分布呈右偏态，这些方案更容易被采纳。我们分析了对Waxman–Markey（WM）总量控制与交易法案的投票。在控制一个选区的CAT收益的条件下，该选区的RFS收益与投票支持WM的可能性呈负相关。我们的分析支持竞选捐款是其中一项部分作用机制的观点。

title: Unintended Consequences of Transportation Carbon Policies
abstract: Renewable fuel standards, low carbon fuel standards, and ethanol subsidies are popular policies to incentivize ethanol production and reduce emissions from transportation. Compared to carbon trading, these policies lead to large shifts in agricultural activity and unexpected social costs. We simulate the 2022 Federal Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) and find that energy crop production increases by 39 million acres. Land-use costs from erosion and habitat loss are between $277 and $693 million.A low carbon fuel standard (LCFS) and ethanol subsidies have similar effects while costs under an equivalent cap and trade (CAT) system are essentially zero. In addition, the alternatives to CAT magnify errors in assigning emissions rates to fuels and can over or under-incentivize innovation. These results highlight the potential negative efficiency effects of the RFS, LCFS and subsidies, effects that would be less severe under a CAT policy.
abstract_zh: 可再生燃料标准、低碳燃料标准和乙醇补贴是激励乙醇生产、减少交通领域排放的常见政策。与碳交易相比，这些政策会引起农业活动的大幅变动和意外的社会成本。我们模拟了2022年联邦可再生燃料标准（RFS），发现能源作物种植面积增加了3900万英亩。侵蚀和栖息地丧失带来的土地利用成本在2.77亿至6.93亿美元之间。低碳燃料标准（LCFS）和乙醇补贴也有类似效果，而等效的总量控制与交易（CAT）体系下的成本基本为零。此外，替代CAT的政策会放大对燃料排放强度赋值的误差，并可能对创新产生过度或不足的激励。这些结果凸显了RFS、LCFS和补贴可能带来的负面效率影响，而在CAT政策下，这些影响会较轻。

The Higher Price of Cleaner Fuels: Market Power in the Rail Transport of Fuel Ethanol
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Greenhouse Gas Reductions under Low Carbon Fuel Standards?
abstract: A low carbon fuel standard (LCFS) seeks to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by limiting a fuel producer's carbon emissions per unit of output. California has launched an LCFS for transportation fuels; others have called for a national LCFS.We show that this policy decreases production of high-carbon fuels but increases production of low-carbon fuels. The net effect of this may be an increase in carbon emissions. The LCFS cannot be first best, and the best LCFS may reduce social welfare. We simulate the outcomes of a national LCFS, focusing on gasoline and ethanol as the high-and low-carbon fuels. For a broad range of parameters, we find that the LCFS is unlikely to increase CO2 emissions. However, the surplus losses from the LCFS are likely to be quite large ($80 to $760 billion annually for a national LCFS reducing carbon intensities by 10 percent), energy prices are likely to increase, and the average carbon cost ($307 to $2,272 per ton of CO2 for the same LCFS) can be much larger than damage estimates. We describe an efficient policy that achieves the same emissions reduction at a much lower surplus cost ($16 to $290 billion) and much lower average carbon cost ($60 to $868 per ton of CO2).
abstract_zh: 低碳燃料标准（LCFS）旨在通过限制燃料生产者每单位产出的碳排放量来减少温室气体排放。加利福尼亚州已为交通燃料推行了LCFS；其他人则呼吁实施全国性的LCFS。我们证明，该政策会减少高碳燃料的生产，但会增加低碳燃料的生产。其净效应可能是碳排放的增加。LCFS不可能达到第一最优，最优的LCFS甚至可能降低社会福利。我们模拟了全国性LCFS的结果，重点关注汽油和乙醇分别作为高碳燃料和低碳燃料的情形。在广泛的参数范围内，我们发现LCFS不太可能增加CO2排放。然而，LCFS带来的剩余损失可能相当大（对于将碳强度降低10%的全国性LCFS，每年为800亿至7600亿美元），能源价格可能上涨，且平均碳成本（同一LCFS下每吨CO2为307至2272美元）可能远高于损害估计值。我们描述了一种有效政策，它能以低得多的剩余成本（160亿至2900亿美元）和低得多的平均碳成本（每吨CO2 60至868美元）实现相同的减排效果。

title: Evidence of a Shift in the Short-Run Price Elasticity of Gasoline Demand
abstract: Understanding the sensitivity of gasoline demand to changes in prices and income has important implications for policies related to climate change, optimal taxation and national security. The short-run price and income elasticities of gasoline demand in the United States during the 1970s and 1980s have been studied extensively. However, transportation analysts have hypothesized that behavioral and structural factors over the past several decades have changed the responsiveness of U.S. consumers to changes in gasoline prices. We compare the price and income elasticities of gasoline demand in two periods of similarly high prices from 1975 to 1980 and 2001 to 2006. The short-run price elasticities differ considerably: and range from -0.034 to -0.077 during 2001 to 2006, versus -0.21 to -0.34 for 1975 to 1980. The estimated short-run income elasticities range from 0.21 to 0.75 and when estimated with the same models are not significantly different between the two periods.
abstract_zh: 理解汽油需求对价格和收入变化的敏感性，对于气候变化、最优税收和国家安全相关的政策具有重要意义。20世纪70年代和80年代美国汽油需求的短期价格和收入弹性已被广泛研究。然而，交通分析人士推测，过去几十年间的行为和结构性因素改变了美国消费者对汽油价格变化的反应程度。我们比较了两个油价同样高企的时期（1975至1980年和2001至2006年）的汽油需求价格弹性和收入弹性。短期价格弹性差异显著：2001至2006年间为-0.034至-0.077，而1975至1980年间为-0.21至-0.34。估计的短期收入弹性范围为0.21至0.75，在使用相同模型估计时，两个时期之间的差异并不显著。
